subject: pathology
title: Arthritis and soft tissue tumours

steps.tx: **Osteoarthritis** (wear and tear, **Heberden DIP with Bouchard PIP nodes**, knee and hip, joint space narrowing with **osteophytes** and sclerosis, no systemic features) is managed by weight loss, physiotherapy, analgesia and arthroplasty; **rheumatoid arthritis** (symmetric **MCP and PIP** with morning stiffness over an hour, **pannus** erosions, **rheumatoid factor with anti CCP**, nodules with Felty and Caplan, **atlantoaxial instability**) needs early **methotrexate** with biologics to remission. Heberden nodes never rheumatoid; ulnar deviation with swan neck deforms RA hands.
steps.say: DIP nodes without systemics are OA: replace late. Symmetric MCP stiffness over an hour is RA: methotrexate early.

steps.tx: **Gout** (hyperuricaemia, **negatively birefringent needle** crystals, **podagra** first MTP, tophi with renal stones, alcohol and diuretics precipitate) is aborted by **colchicine or NSAIDs** (steroids if contraindicated) and prevented by **allopurinol or febuxostat** (HLA-B5801 screening Asians, flare cover on initiation); **pseudogout** (**positively birefringent rhomboid** calcium pyrophosphate, chondrocalcinosis, knee in elderly, haemochromatosis and hyperpara associates) is aspirated with NSAIDs. Joint fluid polarised microscopy decides; serum urate misleads acutely.
steps.say: Needles negative bright podagra is gout: colchicine now, allopurinol later. Rhomboid positive knee is pseudogout.

steps.tx: **Spondyloarthritis** (HLA-B27, sacroiliitis, enthesitis, uveitis) includes **ankylosing spondylitis** (**bamboo spine** with squaring, morning back pain easing exercise, **anti TNF**), psoriatic (DIP with **sausage digits** and nail pitting, methotrexate or biologics), reactive (post dysentery or chlamydia triad with circinate balanitis, self limited with antibiotics for trigger), enteropathic (IBD). **Septic arthritis** (Staph aureus, gonococcal migratory with tenosynovitis, prosthetic) is **urgent washout with IV antibiotics**; crystals never exclude sepsis. Spine MRI sacroiliitis stages.
steps.say: Bamboo morning back easing motion is AS: anti TNF. Hot single joint is septic until washed: never trust crystals alone.

steps.tx: **Soft tissue tumours** sort benign versus malignant: lipoma (soft, slips, observe) versus **liposarcoma** (deep large, MDM2 amplified, wide resection), **GIST** (stomach, **CD117 and DOG1** positive, **imatinib** for KIT mutants), **synovial sarcoma** (young, X;18 SS18-SSX, biphasic, ifosfamide based), embryonal **rhabdomyosarcoma** (orbit in children, VAC chemo) versus alveolar (PAX-FOXO1, worse), **desmoid** (FAP Gardner, beta catenin, infiltrative without metastases, watch or resect), DFSP (storiform, Mohs). Size over 5 cm deep masses biopsy by core.
steps.say: Deep large fatty mass is liposarcoma until MDM2 says otherwise. CD117 gut wall tumour is GIST: imatinib.
